lessons_used: Evidence is still thin for almost all specific kinds of change, as only 'home, wait_info' has been tested more than once.
For 'home, wait_info', one test won while one showed no clear effect, so a definitive pattern is not yet established.
Helpful changes were observed in tests for 'choose_path, hint', 'finish, new_screen', and 'home, wait_info' because those tests won.
No effect was seen for tests in 'home, new_flow', 'adoption, notification', 'sign_in, incentive', 'choose_path, layout', and 'adoption, layout'.
Predictions were generally too high for most tests, though they underpredicted gains on certain winning tests like 'finish, new_screen' and 'home, wait_info'.

candidates.title: Desktop pet interaction cheatsheet screen
candidates.change: Add a dedicated interactive pet command and control cheatsheet screen right after home intro, explaining hotkeys and mouse controls.
candidates.why: Support mail showed multiple complaints from users confused about how to hide, control, or speak to their pet post-onboarding.

new_pet_controls.headline: How to Interact with Your Pet
new_pet_controls.body: Learn the core shortcuts to summon, hide, or chat with your desktop pet anytime.

guard.reason: Valid addition of a pet controls screen following home_intro within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: finish/new_screen is a proven winning category (+9.1%) and addresses direct support complaints.

candidates.title: Move account sign in after pet selection
candidates.change: Reorder the onboarding path so users pick or create their pet before being prompted to sign in.
candidates.why: Sign-in loses 27.1% of users before they build emotional investment in selecting a specific pet companion.

guard.reason: Valid reordering of sign_in step within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Sign-in loses 27.1% of users, but major flow reordering carries moderate risk based on past flow tests.

candidates.title: Spotlight pet pick layout redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the pet picker using a spotlight layout to showcase pet styles prominently.
candidates.why: Adoption conversion drops to 60.9% with a high median selection time of 89s, indicating choice friction.

pick_friend.headline: Choose Your Pet Companion
pick_friend.body: Select your favorite companion style to bring to life on your desktop screen.

guard.reason: Valid spotlight redesign for the pick_friend screen.

candidates.score_note: Adoption has highest drop-off (39.1%), but layout redesigns consistently underperformed or regressed.

candidates.title: Desktop pet setup diagnostic flow
candidates.change: Insert a short display system diagnostic screen to verify multi-monitor rendering before launching the pet.
candidates.why: Support emails report issues where pets do not appear on desktop or the desktop application fails to open.

new_desktop_diagnostic.headline: Verifying Display Setup
new_desktop_diagnostic.body: Checking system tray access and screen overlay compatibility for your pet.

guard.reason: Valid addition of a system diagnostic screen within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Adding new diagnostic steps in home flow aligns with past negative results for new_flow changes.

candidates.title: Desktop system tray hint on waiting screen
candidates.change: Display a notification hint explaining that the pet is initializing in the system tray during startup.
candidates.why: Waiting stage takes a long median time (201s), causing users to think the app stalled or failed to launch.

waiting.hint: Your pet is initializing in your desktop system tray. Look for the tray icon once ready!

guard.reason: Valid system tray hint added to the waiting screen.

candidates.score_note: home/wait_info showed positive average gains (+3.3%) and is a cheap configuration-only update.

candidates.title: Quick creation path headline clarity
candidates.change: Update the headline and description on choose_path screen to explicitly contrast ready preset pets versus custom photos.
candidates.why: Choose path has a high mean duration of 514s, indicating confusion between the two options.

choose_path.headline: How Would You Like to Start?
choose_path.body: Pick a ready-to-play pet companion in seconds, or create a custom pet from your photos.

guard.reason: Valid headline and body copy update maintaining dual path options on choose_path.

candidates.score_note: Copy changes on choose_path regressed in prior tests (-5.3%).

candidates.title: Pet safe-backup guarantee highlight
candidates.change: Add a cloud sync security badge component to the sign-in screen reassuring users that pet state is securely stored.
candidates.why: 8 support emails were received about missing or reset pets after signing back into an account.

components.label: Cloud Sync Protection: Keeps your desktop pet safe across sessions

guard.reason: 'sign_in.components[0].label' must be text up to 40 characters

candidates.title: Photo upload quality tip hint
candidates.change: Provide clear lighting and photo angle guidance directly on the photo upload screen.
candidates.why: Support tickets reported custom pet generation failing or looking wrong during the adoption step.

upload_photos.hint: Use well-lit, front-facing photos with clear contrast for the best pet generation result.

guard.reason: Valid photo quality hint added to upload_photos screen.

candidates.score_note: Targeting the lowest-converting step (60.9%) with hints (which won on choose_path) and support mail evidence.

candidates.title: Background ready desktop alert notification
candidates.change: Enable optional OS tray notification when pet initialization finishes on the waiting screen.
candidates.why: The mean waiting duration is 2336s, showing that users switch away to other tasks while waiting.

guard.reason: Valid notification option added to waiting screen.

candidates.score_note: Notification changes previously showed slight negative impact (-2.0%).

candidates.title: Compact layout redesign for home intro welcome
candidates.change: Switch home intro screen to a compact card layout with direct start action buttons.
candidates.why: Finish step takes a median of 395s; a compact focused layout helps users jump straight to desktop interaction.

home_intro.headline: Your Pet is Ready!
home_intro.body: Your desktop pet companion is active. Click below to begin exploring together.

guard.reason: Valid compact layout redesign for home_intro screen.

candidates.score_note: Layout adjustments generally produce minimal or negative gains across previous tests.

picked: Desktop system tray hint on waiting screen

decisions.title: Desktop system tray hint on waiting screen

shipped: Desktop system tray hint on waiting screen
lessons_next: Evidence is still thin for most specific kinds of change, as only 'finish, new_screen', 'home, wait_info', and 'choose_path, copy' have been tested more than once.
'finish, new_screen' is consistently helpful, supported by two winning tests (+7.2% average after noise correction).
'home, wait_info' is generally helpful, with two winning tests out of three (+3.4% average after noise correction).
Results for 'choose_path, copy' remain inconsistent across tests (one lost, one won), so no definitive pattern is established.
Predictions were generally too high overall, though they underpredicted gains on some winning tests in 'home, wait_info' and 'choose_path, copy'.
